signal.headline: PROVEN LOCKED (CONDITIONAL) — UP
signal.guarantee: PROVEN LOCKED is a conditional price-only test, not a settlement certainty: the engine's own index samples for the passed print seconds, discounted by 0.25 %, keep the 60-print average above the strike even if every remaining print were $0. It holds only if the official prints for those seconds are within 0.25 % of the samples, no print or settlement is revised, and the settlement is the plain 60-print average. Settlement-exposure gate (PR11) met: the remaining 4 settlement prints would have to move 16644.4 bps against the call; the historical floor for 4 s is 12 bps (0.05 % of seconds, 2023-2026).
